title: Opioid prescribing for tooth extraction in the United States, 2021 through 2023
html: Compared with opioids, ibuprofen and acetaminophen are safer and equally effective options for analgesia after tooth extraction. Despite this, researchers found that tooth extraction accounted for 65% of opioid prescriptions dispensed after dental procedures from 2013 through 2018. It is unclear whether this proportion has since changed. In addition, the factors associated with opioid dispensing after tooth extraction are unclear.
